transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?
I've been feeling incredibly depressed, sad, and empty inside for about seven months now. It's just gotten so heavy that I finally decided I needed to come in and get some help.
Did these feelings start after a specific stressful event or major life change, or did they come on without a clear trigger?
I can't really think of any specific stressful event or major life change that triggered this. It just seemed to build up on its own, and these feelings have been going on for about seven months now.
Before these past seven months, had you been feeling down or depressed most days for at least two years, or is this the first time it has lasted this long?

No, this is the first time I've ever felt this down for such a long time. Before these past seven months, I didn't have any history of feeling depressed or sad like this, so this is all very new to me.
During these past seven months, have you also lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?
Yes, I have. I don't care about my hobbies or the things I used to love doing anymore. Nothing brings me any happiness or pleasure now, it all just feels empty.
Have you also had changes in your sleep or appetite, low energy, trouble concentrating, or feelings of worthlessness during this time?

Yes, I've been struggling to concentrate because my mind feels so foggy, and I constantly feel completely worthless. I haven't really noticed any major changes in my sleep, appetite, or energy levels, though.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself or ending your life?
No, I haven't had any thoughts of hurting myself or ending my life. Even though I feel extremely empty and worthless, I don't have any plans or desire to harm myself.
Have you ever had a period lasting several days when you felt unusually energized or euphoric, needed much less sleep, talked more than usual, or felt your thoughts were racing?

No, I've never had any periods like that where I felt high energy or euphoric. My mood has been consistently low and depressed this whole time. I've never experienced racing thoughts or felt like I didn't need to sleep.
How much have these symptoms affected your daily life, like your work, school, relationships, or taking care of yourself?

These symptoms have severely impacted my daily life over the past seven months, making it almost impossible to get any work or basic tasks done because of my complete lack of motivation and poor concentration. I’ve also completely withdrawn from my family and friends, avoiding any social contact because I just don't have the energy or interest to maintain relationships anymore.
